# Point Reyes Sound, Inc.

> Point Reyes Sound is a frontier-tech quantum computing and computational chemistry software company pioneering kinetic transport methods and the Quantum Boltzmann Equation Self-Consistent Field (QBE-SCF) platform.

## Venture Capital & Investment Profile
- **Stage**: Seed Stage Frontier Tech & Deep Tech.
- **Headquarters**: San Francisco, California, USA.
- **Founder & CSO**: Dr. Romit Chakraborty (Ph.D. University of Chicago, postdoctoral training at UC Berkeley / Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, former Senior Computational Scientist at PsiQuantum; co-author of the Q-Chem 5 package).
- **Core Technology & Moat**: Proprietary Quantum Boltzmann Equation Self-Consistent Field (QBE-SCF) platform that eliminates the factorial active-space combinatorial scaling of CASSCF and DMRG, regularizing topological mean-field singularities.
- **Intellectual Property**: U.S. Provisional Patent Application No. 64/033,274 ("Method and System for Quantum Boltzmann Self-Consistent Field Computation and Mean-Field Regularization").
- **Commercial Addressable Market (SAM)**: $15B+ high-performance computational chemistry, materials simulation, clean energy storage electrolytes, wide-bandgap power electronics, and semiconductor EDA.
- **Strategic Accelerator & Cloud Backing**: Member of NVIDIA Inception Program; Google Cloud Research Grant recipient; USISTEF Quantum Materials Foundry partner.
- **Investor Inbound & Seed Deck Requests**: directors@pointreyessound.com | romit@pointreyessound.com

## Core Research & Capabilities
- **Quantum Boltzmann Equation Self-Consistent Field (QBE-SCF)**: Reformulates electronic self-consistency as kinetic relaxation of the one-electron reduced density matrix (1-RDM) via a Bhatnagar-Gross-Krook (BGK) collision operator.
- **Topological Singularity Regularization**: Resolves Coulson-Fischer singular cusps, conical intersections, and static correlation catastrophes without exponential combinatorial active space expansions.
- **Fault-Tolerant Quantum Algorithm Compilation (FTQC)**: Classical active-space pre-relaxation achieving a 1,747× reduction in Toffoli gate complexity (1.66 × 10⁹ T-gates, 168 logical qubits on Cr₂) against full-system FTQC benchmarks under photonic and superconducting error-correction constraints.
- **Hardware Acceleration**: High-performance CUDA and Tensor Core GPU kernels accelerated via NVIDIA Inception Program and Google Cloud Research Grants.
